candidates.event: Phase III trial: personalised mRNA melanoma vaccine intismeran plus pembrolizumab cuts recurrence or death risk by 42% at two years

facts.claim: Trial of 1,137 high-risk patients with surgically removed melanoma; combination reduced risk of recurrence or death by 42% versus pembrolizumab alone at two years
facts.quote: reduced the risk of melanoma recurrence or death by 42% compared with treatment with pembrolizumab alone

facts.claim: 82% alive and recurrence-free at two years on the combination versus 70% on pembrolizumab alone
facts.quote: 82% were alive and recurrence-free after two years, compared with 70% of participants treated with pembrolizumab alone

facts.claim: First individualised cancer vaccine with positive phase III results
facts.quote: It is the first individualised cancer vaccine to show positive results in a phase III clinical trial.

facts.claim: Results accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine and to be presented at the ESMO congress in Madrid this weekend
facts.quote: The results have been accepted for publication in the New England Journal of Medicine.

candidates.notes: Nature (s335) text did not load; only its headline (Moderna vaccine almost halves risk) supports the second source. Independent expert notes a significant portion do not respond and the effect beyond two years is unknown. Not yet regulator-approved.

candidates.event: Study: heat killed an estimated 50,391 people in 854 European cities in summer 2026, about 32,619 attributed to human-caused warming

facts.claim: Modelled 50,391 heat deaths in 854 European cities in June-August, of which 32,619 attributed to climate change from burning fossil fuels; study in Nature Health
facts.quote: 50,391 people died from warmer temperatures, and of those, 32,619 died because of the extra heat caused by the burning of coal, oil and gas

facts.claim: 71% above the previous deadliest summer (29,480 in 2022); likely an underestimate, cities cover about 40% of Europe's population
facts.quote: That's 71% higher than the previous deadliest summer, which was 29,480 in 2022

facts.claim: Highest tolls in Italy, France, Spain and Germany
facts.quote: Italy, France, Spain and Germany had the highest death tolls, the study said.

candidates.notes: Modelled estimates from a published study (Imperial College London); single outlet in bundle.

candidates.event: NASA update on Artemis: Artemis III docking test in Earth orbit summer 2027, first landing (Artemis IV) still targeted for 2028

facts.claim: NASA says Artemis III, a crewed Earth-orbit docking test with SpaceX and Blue Origin landers, is on track for next summer, with no lunar trip
facts.quote: still on track to launch Artemis III next summer on a docking exercise

facts.claim: Artemis IV, first crewed landing since Apollo, remains scheduled for 2028
facts.quote: The all-important Artemis IV—NASA's first moon landing by astronauts since Apollo—remains scheduled for 2028

facts.claim: NASA will choose between SpaceX and Blue Origin for the Artemis IV lander later
facts.quote: NASA will keep its options open as long as possible before choosing between SpaceX and Blue Origin

facts.claim: Revised architecture: Orion to dock with Starship in high-Earth orbit before heading to the Moon; Blue Origin plan uses four New Glenn launches
facts.quote: the revised plan calls for the Orion spacecraft to dock with the Starship lunar lander in high-Earth orbit before transiting to the Moon

candidates.notes: Based on a NASA news conference reported by two outlets. Schedule reaffirmed with architecture changes; moderate novelty.

facts.quote: The agency recorded at least seven aftershocks of magnitudes between 4.3 and 5.2

facts.quote: we have more evidence that dark energy may change over time
